form_fields.name_help: Put your full name and in these boxes. Please do not use nicknames or initials. If this application is for a change of name you will be asked for your previous name in a later section. And don't forget to include your title (Mr., Mrs., Miss, Ms.). The pre-determined options for the Title field are dictated by the National Mail Voter Registration Form, and this field is required by some states. They are not reflective of Rock the Vote's views or values on gender inclusivity.
form_fields.home_address_help: Put your home address in these boxes. Do not put your mailing address here if it is different from your home address. Do not use a post office box or rural route without a box number. If you live in a rural area or do not have a street address, please show where you live using the map on the printed form.
form_fields.mailing_address_help: Put your home mailing in these boxes only if it is different from your home address. If you do not receive mail at your home address you must fill out this section to indicate where you can be reached by mail.
form_fields.changed_address_help: If you have moved since your last registration, enter your previous address.
form_fields.dob_help: On your voter registration application, you are required to indicate whether you will be 18 years old on or before election day. However, many states allow you to register before your 18th birthday, so see the rules for your state.
form_fields.phone_help: Most states ask for your telephone number in case there are questions about your application. You are not required to provide your phone number.

pennsylvania.declaration:
I declare that
  • I am a United States citizen and will have been a citizen for at least 1 month on the day of the next election.
  • I will be at least 18 years old on the day of the next election.
  • I will have lived at the address in section 5 for at least 30 days before the election.
  • I am legally qualified to vote.
I affirm that this information is true. I understand that this declaration is the same as an affidavit, and, if this information is not true, I can be convicted of perjury, and fined up to $15,000, jailed for up to 7 years, or both.
By checking the box below, you are signing the application electronically. In doing so:
  • You agree you have read and accept the terms of the declaration above.
  • You understand that your electronic signature on this application will constitute the legal equivalent of your signature for this voter registration application.
  • You agree to conduct this voter registration transaction by electronic means and that all laws of the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania will apply to this transaction.
pennsylvania.declaration2: If you provided your PA driver's license or PennDOT ID number, you understand that the signathure from the PennDOT record will constituet your signature oon your voter registration record. If you upload an image of your signature, you understand that the signature you upload will cinstitute your signature on your voter registration record. You understand that you do not have to register electronically, and may use a paper or other non-electronic from of this voter registration application.
pennsylvania.i_confirm: I confirm that I have read and agree to the terms above.
pennsylvania.you_must_confirm: You must confirm that you agree to the terms above.
